llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam indicators: 1) Unusually low prices on name-brand products and huge claimed sales numbers suggest product legitimacy is faked. 2) The payment methods are limited to cryptocurrency (including Binance, Huobi, OKX, MetaMask, etc.), which is highly unorthodox and favored by scammers due to irreversibility and anonymity. 3) Company information is ambiguous and references non-existent or misused entities (e.g., falsely citing Shopify's address). 4) Urgency and guarantee claims ('100% Original', '100% Rate of good reviews') are overused psychology-targeting tactics. 5) The privacy, contact, and legal pages are ambiguous. 6) The product range is inconsistent and mimics large legitimate platforms without credible branding. These factors strongly indicate a fake online shopping scam.
